instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Stick to Midnight Blue (#0A0E27) and Gold (#C9A961).
Use framer-motion for smooth scroll reveals and parallax elements. Make sure to stagger children in grids.
Implement the floating 'Confirmar Asistencia' CTA that stays visible and scrolls along. It should jump/scroll to the RSVP section.
Custom dark-theme Shadcn forms: Ensure form fields have readable text, dark backgrounds, and gold focus rings.
Ensure the hero overlay has a strong gradient so the text is crisp and readable.
Include a React-based countdown timer in the hero.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
NO EMOJIS anywhere. Use lucide-react exclusively.
Ensure there is a /admin route displaying a simple Shadcn table for the RSVPs.
